items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: entertainers are making more money than Babe Ruth made in one week, or in one month

ctx.x: But unfortunately it's just unbelievable how the paper work and the contracts in this business are so badly arranged for the artists, and it's hard to believe now that in these days of 1975 that entertainers are making more money than Babe Ruth made in one week, or in one month, you know.
